description:
Delete a folder, its items and its share link at once (the link stops working). The
    hooks and finds in it, and their keeps, stay. Returns {"folder_id", "deleted": true}.
    Same as DELETE /v1/folders/{folder_id}. Free. Errors: 404 folder_not_found.

folder_id.description: one of your folders (from list_folders or create_folder)
folder_id.title: Folder Id

name: delete_folder
